newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 falls as Wall St. jitters hit high caps.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 falls as Wall St. jitters hit high caps.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index tumbled 1.2 percent at Monday's price fixing after Wall Street fell more than three percent on Friday, prompting sharp losses on major European bourses in early Monday trading.
Although the Czech market is far less sensitive than western markets to movements on the major world bourses, analysts said that they had already seen a wave of selling orders from foreign investors.
"We saw sellers from abroad," said John Vax, director of capital markets at ING Barings in Prague.
The brunt of the losses were bourne by the most highly capitalised issues. SPT Telecom dropped 85 crowns to 4,175, Komercni Banka was down 56 crowns to 1,834 and CEZ lost 27 crowns to 904.
Vax said that some of the losses in early over-the-counter trading had been even more substantial indicating that the bourse may see heavier falls during continuous trading.
